title: Run one bounded signed GMGN wallet-holdings history-field pilot for one Owner-supplied Solana wallet
objective: After confirming only the presence of GMGN_API_KEY and GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY, manually run exactly one signed, read-only GMGN `portfolio holdings` request for the one frozen Owner-supplied public Solana wallet below. Strictly Base58-decode and validate the wallet as exactly 32 bytes before spawning the CLI. Use the installed gmgn-cli with Solana, limit 50, total-profit descending, hide-abnormal true, hide-airdrop true and hide-closed false so the pilot can establish only whether the first returned page exposes documented historical-profit and activity fields. Capture stdout/stderr only in process memory; commit only a sanitized report containing safe request-bound evidence, response-shape availability, first-page bounded counts and allowlisted numeric aggregates if safely parsed. This is a borrowed/unverified provider observation, not a full wallet-history, a chain-confirmed PnL result, a quality judgment or an Alpha tier.
forbidden_actions: Do not call a chain other than Solana or a provider other than GMGN.
Do not run more than one GMGN CLI invocation; do not paginate, retry, discover, substitute a wallet, call Helius or invoke any other GMGN command.

Do not print, persist, commit or quote API keys, private keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw GMGN payloads, arbitrary provider text, full exception text, token mints, token names, transaction signatures, counterparties or per-trade records.

Do not claim complete all-time wallet PnL, a chain-confirmed realized profit, win rate, wallet quality, wallet classification, common ownership, clustering, address-library admission or Alpha N/R/SR/SSR/UR tier.
Do not write a database, cache, queue, address library, scheduler, production system, transaction, signing, swap, order or trade.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.
